saved_B1_mapping_response.interpretation: B1 jointly changes support and queries. Changed scores for unchanged full query rows establish context-side or batch-path influence, not an isolated causal effect of the query source port. Frozen preprocessing is unchanged; no claim about which internal support rows caused the response.

strict_monotone_calibration.identity: For strictly increasing f: f(s)>f(t) iff s>t. Transforming calibration order statistic and query scores together therefore preserves all decisions, ranks and ties.
strict_monotone_calibration.scope: common scalar strictly increasing transform; does not cover group-dependent transformations or new conditional scores
